description: A part read as sheet metal.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

sheet_metal.description: True when the part is sheet metal (it has a SheetMetal feature). When false, nothing below is given.

bend_radius_mm.description: The default inner bend radius, mm.

k_factor.description: The K-factor: where the neutral layer sits across the thickness, more than 0 and at most 1 (0.5 is the middle). The bend develops to angle × (inner radius + K × thickness).

allowance_mm.description: The bend allowance itself, mm, more than 0: the length the bend develops to, whatever its angle.

deduction_mm.description: The bend deduction, mm, 0 or more: what the bend takes off the sum of the two flanges' outer lengths to the virtual sharp.

allowance.description: The default bend allowance; empty when SOLIDWORKS takes it from a bend or gauge table, which is not read.

relief.description: The automatic relief; absent when there is none or it is not rectangular, obround or tear.

relief_ratio.description: The relief's size as a ratio of the thickness.

sheet_bodies.description: How many solid bodies are sheet metal (one, in a part this server made).

other_bodies.description: How many solid bodies are ordinary solids beside the sheet.

items.description: A bend of a sheet-metal part, as SOLIDWORKS reads it back.

name.description: Its name, for example EdgeBend1 or BaseBend1.

reference.description: Its persistent reference (a feature reference). References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

feature.description: The feature it belongs to, for example Base-Flange1.

angle_deg.description: How far it bends, degrees: 90 for a right angle.

k_factor.description: The K-factor: where the neutral layer sits across the thickness, more than 0 and at most 1 (0.5 is the middle). The bend develops to angle × (inner radius + K × thickness).

allowance_mm.description: The bend allowance itself, mm, more than 0: the length the bend develops to, whatever its angle.

deduction_mm.description: The bend deduction, mm, 0 or more: what the bend takes off the sum of the two flanges' outer lengths to the virtual sharp.

allowance.description: How it develops when flattened; empty when SOLIDWORKS takes it from a bend or gauge table, which is not read.

default_radius.description: True when its radius is the part's default.

default_allowance.description: True when its allowance is the part's default.

width_mm.description: How long it is along its axis, mm; absent when its axis is not along x, y or z.

reference.description: Its persistent reference (r1.<kind>.…), to pass to other operations; absent when SOLIDWORKS cannot give one. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

name.description: Its name, for features, planes, axes and points.

feature.description: The feature that made it, for faces, edges and vertices. An edge or vertex where several features meet names the first; see features.

features.description: For edges and vertices, every feature that made a face it lies on: the circular edge of a hole cut in a boss belongs to both.

geometry.description: Its shape: plane, cylinder, cone, sphere, torus, line, circle, ellipse, spline, point or other.

normal.description: Outward normal of a planar face, or the normal of a plane.

axis.description: Axis of a cylinder, cone, circle or axis; direction of a line.

origin.description: A point on it: a planar face's or edge's centre, a circle's or cylinder's centre on its axis, a vertex or point itself.

radius_mm.description: Radius of a cylinder, cone base, sphere, torus or circle, mm.

min.description: The corner with the smallest coordinates.

max.description: The corner with the largest coordinates.

box.description: Its axis-aligned bounding box, for faces only.

distance_mm.description: Distance from the point model.find was asked to be near, mm.

base_face.description: The sheet's largest planar face, with its reference; absent when its body has no planar face.

length_mm.description: The rectangle's length (its longer side), mm.

bends.description: How many bends the cut list counts.

flat.description: The flat pattern's size from the cut list; absent when the cut list does not give it as numbers.

cut_list.description: Every property of the sheet's cut-list item, as name = value, in SOLIDWORKS' own names and the part's units.
